title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Data entry specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data entry specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.
Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Accounting analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.
You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.
Specifically, your role will involve:
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.
The ideal profile
We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Travel Buddies Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.
Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.
Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:
Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.
Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per Whats App, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.
Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.
Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per Whats App und im Video-Call.
Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, Whats App Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas
Was wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a
uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos
de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,
com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais

exclusiva
para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta
não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?
Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?
Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Accounting analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.
You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.
Specifically, your role will involve:
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.
The ideal profile
We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:
Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.
Next steps in the process ✅
First Interview:
A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:
A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with Move Up Media. Third Interview:
A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:
A proposition for us to start working together!
What’s in it for you
Remote Work Environment:
Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:
We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:
As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:
Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:
€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.
Move Up Media
We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!
Here at Move Up Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Power engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM
Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.
The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution. Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.
Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems. Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects. Familiarity with transmission line design software such as: PLS-CADD SAG10 ETAP Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.
What We're Looking For Self-motivated and results-driven professional. Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines. Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy. Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills. Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development. Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

description:

Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile); Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes; Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão; Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos; Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações; Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.
Requerimentos & Skills: Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas; Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo Power Point, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos. Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e In Design) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais; Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente; Inglês avançado/fluente.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!
Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!
A
Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.
Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:
você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de
22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.
Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.
*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*
O que oferecemos?
Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a
uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos
de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,
com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais
com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma
exclusiva
para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?
Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.
Necessário:
Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta
não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?
Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.
O que buscamos: Estamos em busca de um Designer gráfico para o time de impressão, que seja
capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica). O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe In Design já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

title: Legal analyst
description:

Description We are seeking an experienced
Legal Analyst
to support a growing U. S.-based law firm specializing in commercial transactions and corporate legal matters. This 100% remote position will work directly with attorneys to draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of legal agreements while assisting with corporate governance, due diligence, legal research, and select mergers and acquisitions (M&A) matters.

Prepare first drafts of legal documents using attorney guidance and firm templates. Conduct legal research related to commercial, corporate, contract, and business law matters. Assist attorneys with corporate governance matters, entity formations, annual filings, and corporate record maintenance. Support mergers and acquisitions activities, including due diligence, document organization, disclosure schedules, and transaction closing checklists. Review contracts for legal, commercial, and business risks and summarize key issues for attorney review. Coordinate contract execution, signature collection, and final document management. Maintain organized electronic legal files and document management systems. Track transaction timelines, deadlines, and attorney action items across multiple client matters. Assist with client correspondence and preparation of legal deliverables. Support process improvements and standardization of legal templates and document workflows.
Requirements Education & Licensure:
Law Degree (LL. B., J. D., or regional equivalent) from an accredited law school.
Active bar admission/license to practice law
from Brazil, or a relevant international jurisdiction is strictly required. Experience:
5–10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) practicing corporate law, either within a reputable law firm or as in-house counsel. M&A Expertise:
Proven track record of actively working on M&A transactions and drafting/negotiating complex purchase agreements. Language:
Native or bilingual fluency in
English (written and spoken)
is mandatory, with the ability to draft complex legal documents in English. U. S. Context:
Deep experience supporting U. S.-based companies, cross-border transactions, or working under common law principles. Negotiation Skills:
Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.
Technical Requirements Document Management:
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word (specifically tracking changes and document comparison), Excel, and Google Workspace. Legal Tech:
Experience utilizing Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms (e.g., Ironclad, Docu Sign, Contract Works) and digital signature workflows. Collaboration:
Comfortable operating in agile, remote environments using tools like Teams, Slack, and Zoom. Innovation:
Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, specialized legal AI) to drive legal operations efficiency and streamline workflows.

description: Confira esta oportunidade para Investidor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar O Cenário Atual Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes. O Problema do Mercado Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo. A Solução Yummi A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login. Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas. Destinação do Capital e Custos Base Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável. Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável? Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)
About Pocket FM
Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.
As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional
Brazilian Voice Over Artists

This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.

Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese. Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles. Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting. Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet. Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules. Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.
Nice to Have Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management Experience working remotely with production teams
Engagement Details Contract Type:
Freelance / Independent Contractor Location:
Remote (Work from your own studio) Compensation:
Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis. How to Apply :
Please fill in
UJ9 MNZCs92n U8
What happens after you apply?
Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline: 1. Internal Evaluation: Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects. 2. 150 to 300 hours

20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Solutions architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B) WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED... SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB (or another No SQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders. HOW YOU'LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

ii

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Data entry specialist
description:

Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Solutions architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B )
WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.
IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.
WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB (or another No SQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.
HOW YOU’LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Engenheiro de ia sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de ia sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a)
Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do
Plataforma Agents de IA
— nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.
Esta não é
uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em
confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação
de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.
O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:
•
Orquestrador:
Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/Open IA/Gemini/Deep Seek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. •
Agentes (@dev,@qa,@sec,@devops,@pm,@po,@sm,@analyst,@architect,@data-engineer,@ux-design-expert):
cada um com persona, authority matrix
definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. •
Rules:
Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. •
Recovery loops:
quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. •
Multi-repo via submodules:
projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. •
Stack:
Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/Type Script (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/Git Hub via curl + retry policy.
O que você vai fazer
Manutenção do core (40%) • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.
Evolução de agents e rules (35%) • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex:@dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).
Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%) • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, Open AI CLI, Gemini CLI, Deep Seek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: Deep Seek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.
O que esperamos de você
Stack técnica — obrigatório •
Bash/Shell avançado e Linux
— você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa. •
Node.js / Type Script
— escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando
não
usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). •
Git e Git Hub avançado
— cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, Git Hub Actions workflows. •
Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos
— você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que
não

Recovery loops:
quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. •
Multi-repo via submodules:
projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. •

Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/Type Script (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/Git Hub via curl + retry policy.

O Problema do Mercado Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo. A Solução Yummi A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login. Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas. Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável? Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.
