title: Parceiro(a) de expansão — Consórcios Informais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Parceiro(a) de expansão — Consórcios Informais em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Junta é uma ferramenta nativa do WhatsApp criada para consórcios informais no Brasil, ajudando organizadores a gerenciar participantes, contribuições, pagamentos e comunicação diretamente pelo WhatsApp. Estamos procurando uma pessoa baseada no Brasil para ajudar a expandir a Junta e construir relacionamento com organizadores de consórcios informais em diferentes comunidades e redes locais.


antes de continuar lendo

Essa vaga não é necessariamente pra quem tem experiência com consórcio de administradora, banco ou financeira. A gente procura alguém que conhece o consórcio como ele acontece na prática: entre conhecidos, na comunidade, no boca a boca.


Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e entrar em contato com organizadores de consórcios informais em comunidades, grupos locais, igrejas, salões, redes pessoais e profissionais
  • Construir relacionamento e apresentar a Junta de forma simples e humana para potenciais parceiros
  • Ajudar no onboarding de novos usuários e acompanhar de perto como eles usam a ferramenta
  • Criar parcerias através de comunidades, grupos locais e networking
  • Compartilhar feedback real do campo para ajudar o produto a melhorar e crescer no Brasil
  • Fazer outreach via WhatsApp, LinkedIn, telefone e redes pessoais


Requisitos

  • Português nativo e morar no Brasil
  • Ter participado, organizado, convivido de perto com consórcios informais ou no mínimo entender como funcionam na prática
  • Boa rede de contatos — especialmente em comunidades, bairros e grupos locais
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para criar relacionamentos e confiança
  • Perfil proativo e com jeito empreendedor — vai atrás, resolve, não espera o manual

Diferencial

  • Experiência em vendas, parcerias, business development ou crescimento de comunidades


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto e horário flexível (formato freelance)
  • Modelo de remuneração flexível (fixo + comissão ou apenas comissão)
  • Oportunidade de crescimento junto com a empresa
  • Participação em uma startup focada no mercado brasileiro


Como se candidatar

Manda uma mensagem contando quem você é, como você conhece o mundo dos consórcios informais e como faria para buscar administrares de consórcio para a Junta.

title: Analista Contábil / Product Support Specialist — Brasil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Contábil / Product Support Specialist — Brasil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Dataico Ltda , queremos construir uma plataforma imbuída de inteligência artificial para resolver o problema de gerenciar empresas em massa. ✨


Buscamos um PRODUCT SUPPORT SPECIALIST para nos ajudar a liderar de forma estratégica o atendimento técnico e tributário aos nossos clientes no Brasil, resolvendo dúvidas sobre o produto com uma abordagem AI-first, atuando como um híbrido entre suporte e produto para escalar a operação.

O candidato ideal para esta posição é uma máquina de aprendizado que valoriza o trabalho em equipe, a comunicação e se destaca em ambientes acelerados e de alta performance.


Os valores que nos definem são:

● Mentalidade de Crescimento: acreditamos que o aprendizado dá significado e alegria ao trabalho.

● Comunicação Direta e Honesta: o feedback direto e honesto é fundamental — como mais poderíamos melhorar?

● Viés para a Ação: fazemos as coisas acontecerem.

● Trabalho em Equipe: valorizamos o time acima de estrelas individuais.


Responsabilidades:

● Liderar a vinculação de clientes (certificados e-CNPJ e integração com SEFAZ/Prefeituras) e resolver dúvidas técnico-normativas via canais digitais.

● Diagnosticar e solucionar incidentes técnicos da plataforma, garantindo respostas verdadeiras e atualizadas.

● Analisar chamados (tickets) recorrentes para identificar oportunidades de automação e propor melhorias no fluxo do cliente.

● Implementar fluxos de trabalho (low-code) que reduzam a intervenção humana em tarefas repetitivas de suporte.

● Estruturar documentação e respostas que sirvam de base de treinamento para futuros modelos de atendimento automático.

● Traduzir as necessidades legais e técnicas do mercado brasileiro em especificações claras para a equipe de Produto na Colômbia.

● Validar (QA de Localização) se as atualizações desenvolvidas na Colômbia funcionam corretamente sob a normativa e o contexto do Brasil.

● Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com a matriz para conectar a estratégia do Brasil à infraestrutura global da Dataico.


Requisitos de formação acadêmica e experiência:

● Bacharelado em Ciências Contábeis (obrigatório).

● Registro no CRC ativo e regular (com processo junto ao CRC-SP caso resida fora de SP).

● Aprovação no Exame de Suficiência do CFC.

● Mínimo de 2-3 anos de experiência em suporte técnico para empresas SaaS contábeis ou ERPs.

● Experiência no uso de IA (LLMs, Agentes) e prototipagem rápida (Vibe Coding).


Se as características acima combinam com você, temos muito interesse em conversar!


Você pode escrever para:

title: Sap Finance Control Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sap Finance Control Consultant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP Finance (FI) and Controlling (CO) implementations, enhancements, and support activities.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP FICO solutions.
  • Configure and support General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Product Costing.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to design scalable solutions.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing processes.
  • Perform system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Prepare functional specifications and work closely with ABAP developers on custom developments.
  • Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous process improvements.
  • Participate in SAP S/4HANA migration, transformation, and rollout projects.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands-on SAP FICO consulting experience.
  • Strong expertise in SAP FI and CO configuration and support.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations or migrations.
  • Deep understanding of financial accounting processes and management reporting.
  • Experience integrating SAP FICO with MM, SD, PP, EWM, and other SAP modules.
  • Ability to lead workshops, gather requirements, and communicate with executive stakeholders.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in global SAP rollout programs.
  • Knowledge of SAP Central Finance, Group Reporting, FSCM, or Treasury.
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification preferred.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, or consumer products.

Key Skills

  • SAP FI/CO Configuration
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance
  • General Ledger (GL)
  • Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (AR)
  • Asset Accounting (AA)
  • Cost Center & Profit Center Accounting
  • Internal Orders & Product Costing
  • Financial Closing & Reporting
  • Integration with MM, SD, PP
  • Functional Specifications & Testing
  • Stakeholder Management

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LATAM Accountant

Brazil | Remote


About Sycomp

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.


About the Role


We are looking for a detail-oriented LATAM Accountant to support accounting operations across multiple countries in the region. This role will play a key part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end close, and ensuring compliance with GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.


You will work closely with internal finance teams and external partners, supporting day-to-day accounting activities while contributing to accurate and timely financial reporting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the full month-end close process for assigned LATAM entities, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare and post journal entries, reconcile balance sheet and intercompany accounts
  • Review and validate transactions across AP, AR, billing, and financial operations
  • Maintain alignment between Oracle and local statutory books
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing required documentation
  • Execute tax accounting activities and support statutory compliance across LATAM
  • Ensure adherence to internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Sales Operations, Tax, Legal, and external providers


Requirements

  • CPA (or equivalent certification) required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • Minimum 4 years of accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP / IFRS and accounting operations
  • Experience with AP processes and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Solid understanding of LATAM tax and statutory compliance (Brazil experience preferred)
  • Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred)
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

title: Investidor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investidor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI

Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar

O Cenário Atual

Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.

O Problema do Mercado

Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.

A Solução Yummi

A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.

Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento

O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.

Destinação do Capital e Custos Base

Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.

Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?

  • Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: FinCrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FinCrime Analyst - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.


People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.


We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources
  • Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks
  • Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences
  • Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership
  • Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards
  • Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.g., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks
  • Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures


What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • 2+ years of FinCrime experience
  • Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Impeccable attention to detail
  • The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure


Nice to have

  • A degree in law or STEM subject
  • A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS)
  • Fluency in other languages


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Video Editor (Paid Ads / Performance Content)

Talent Global LLC — Latin America (Remote)

Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client (a US-based Creative Agency/Venture Studio) is looking for a hands-on Video Editor with strong experience creating paid ads content for social platforms. This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow.


Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form video ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms
  • Work from creative briefs to produce polished, on-brand ad creatives
  • Edit performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce style content optimized for conversion, not just aesthetics
  • Apply strong pacing, transitions, typography, and hooks suited for paid ad environments
  • Use AI tools within the editing workflow and stay current on new AI-driven editing/production tools
  • Share relevant AI workflows or tool discoveries with the broader creative team
  • Complete assigned edits independently and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, iterative environment
  • Collaborate with the creative/marketing team on revisions and performance-based iteration


Requirements

  • Minimum 6 years of hands-on video editing experience

title: Global Head of Customer Support
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Head of Customer Support em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives.
  • Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management
  • Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance
  • Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers.
  • Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently.
  • Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including FreshService and equivalent service management platforms
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization
  • Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities.
  • Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within SaaS or software businesses.
  • Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong technical acumen across SaaS architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases
  • Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence.
  • Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation.
  • Familiarity with FreshService or equivalent enterprise service management platforms.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale.
  • Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).


This is a CLT role R$40-50K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

antes de continuar lendo

Essa vaga não é necessariamente pra quem tem experiência com consórcio de administradora, banco ou financeira. A gente procura alguém que conhece o consórcio como ele acontece na prática: entre conhecidos, na comunidade, no boca a boca.

  • Ajudar no onboarding de novos usuários e acompanhar de perto como eles usam a ferramenta
  • Criar parcerias através de comunidades, grupos locais e networking
  • Compartilhar feedback real do campo para ajudar o produto a melhorar e crescer no Brasil
  • Fazer outreach via WhatsApp, LinkedIn, telefone e redes pessoais


Requisitos

  • Português nativo e morar no Brasil
  • Ter participado, organizado, convivido de perto com consórcios informais ou no mínimo entender como funcionam na prática
  • Boa rede de contatos — especialmente em comunidades, bairros e grupos locais
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para criar relacionamentos e confiança
  • Perfil proativo e com jeito empreendedor — vai atrás, resolve, não espera o manual

title: FinCrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FinCrime Analyst - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.


People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.


We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources
  • Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks
  • Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences
  • Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership
  • Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards
  • Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.g., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks
  • Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures


What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • 2+ years of FinCrime experience
  • Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Impeccable attention to detail
  • The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure


Nice to have

  • A degree in law or STEM subject
  • A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS)
  • Fluency in other languages


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Product Manager - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Manager - Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de pessoas Product Managers Sênior com forte visão de negócio e capacidade de execução para liderar a evolução de nossos produtos digitais. No GRUPO SBF, nossos PMs atuam na interseção entre estratégia, dados, tecnologia e experiência do usuário, transformando desafios complexos em soluções digitais escaláveis.

Esta é uma banca de talentos estratégica para posições que impactam diretamente a eficiência operacional e a geração de valor do grupo. Buscamos profissionais que joguem em alto nível, que saibam navegar por ambientes ambíguos e que queiram liderar transformações reais no ecossistema do esporte.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Orientação a Resultados e Negócio: Conectar a estratégia do produto diretamente aos KPIs críticos do negócio, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Decisões Baseadas em Dados: Estabelecer uma cultura analítica forte, utilizando dados quantitativos e qualitativos para embasar o roadmap, priorizações e hipóteses.
  • Inovação e Eficiência com IA: Explorar e integrar o uso de Inteligência Artificial e automações para otimizar processos internos, melhorar a experiência do usuário e acelerar o time-to-market.
  • Alinhamento de Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de diversas áreas (comercial, operações, marketing, etc.) em produtos digitais funcionais, garantindo uma adoção real e sustentável pelas frentes de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e desdobrar a visão, estratégia e o roadmap do produto, alinhando a tecnologia às necessidades de crescimento da companhia;
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery contínuos com usuários, clientes e áreas de negócio não-digitais, transformando dores reais em soluções de software;
  • Atuar com forte viés analítico, definindo, monitorando e comunicando KPIs claros de produto e impacto no negócio;
  • Avaliar cenários de Build vs. Buy (desenvolvimento interno vs. contratação de fornecedores), considerando custos, prazos e escalabilidade;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e parceiros de sistemas corporativos (como SAP e plataformas de mercado);
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto com metodologias ágeis, garantindo a qualidade das entregas e a melhoria contínua;
  • Liderar e influenciar stakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio , com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais;
  • Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos);
  • Experiência sólida na gestão, priorização e refinamento de roadmaps e backlogs usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Comunicação clara, articulada e excelente habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência ou interesse prático na aplicação de soluções de IA (Inteligência Artificial) , LLMs ou automações avançadas no dia a dia do produto;
  • Experiência com sistemas corporativos e integrações complexas (ex: ERPs como SAP, CRMs, ferramentas de Analytics);
  • Domínio de ferramentas analíticas (SQL, Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Histórico em projetos de transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados.


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias;
  • Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto;
  • Capacidade de entrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue;
  • Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders.

title: Senior Video Editor – Paid Ads & Performance Marketing
description:

Video Editor (Paid Ads / Performance Content)

Talent Global LLC — Latin America (Remote)

Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client (a US-based Creative Agency/Venture Studio) is looking for a hands-on Video Editor with strong experience creating paid ads content for social platforms. This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow.


Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form video ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms
  • Work from creative briefs to produce polished, on-brand ad creatives
  • Edit performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce style content optimized for conversion, not just aesthetics
  • Apply strong pacing, transitions, typography, and hooks suited for paid ad environments
  • Use AI tools within the editing workflow and stay current on new AI-driven editing/production tools
  • Share relevant AI workflows or tool discoveries with the broader creative team
  • Complete assigned edits independently and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, iterative environment
  • Collaborate with the creative/marketing team on revisions and performance-based iteration


Requirements

  • Minimum 6 years of hands-on video editing experience
  • Direct experience editing paid ad creatives for performance marketing, DTC, or e-commerce brands
  • Strong command of editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of an editing workflow (nice to have: exposure to Runway, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Pika, or similar)
  • Ability to work full-time, aligned with US business hours
  • Strong portfolio specifically showcasing paid social / ad creative editing (not just general video work)


Ideal Candidate

This person is an editor first — someone who thrives on turning a brief into a finished, high-performing ad creative rather than driving concept or direction. They have real, seasoned experience in the performance marketing/DTC/e-commerce space and understand what makes an ad creative convert, not just look good. They're comfortable with AI tools as part of their toolkit and curious about new workflows, but their core strength is editing execution. They're reliable, fast, and can work independently within a full-time schedule.

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist


Who We Are:

Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.


Your Role:

As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.


You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk

or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.


Why this role matters:

Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.


Responsibilities:

  • Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.


  • Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.


  • Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.


  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.


  • Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.


  • Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard


What We’re Looking For:

Must-haves:

  • Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one.
  • Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility.
  • Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone.
  • Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants.
  • Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection.
  • Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product.
  • Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows.
  • Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Legal Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Legal Analyst


Description

We are seeking an experienced Legal Analyst to support a growing U.S.-based law firm specializing in commercial transactions and corporate legal matters. This 100% remote position will work directly with attorneys to draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of legal agreements while assisting with corporate governance, due diligence, legal research, and select mergers and acquisitions (M&A) matters.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, fluent in English (written and spoken), experienced supporting U.S.-based attorneys or businesses, and comfortable managing multiple legal projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.


Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, edit, and redline commercial agreements, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), service agreements, purchase agreements, and amendments.
  • Prepare first drafts of legal documents using attorney guidance and firm templates.
  • Conduct legal research related to commercial, corporate, contract, and business law matters.
  • Assist attorneys with corporate governance matters, entity formations, annual filings, and corporate record maintenance.
  • Support mergers and acquisitions activities, including due diligence, document organization, disclosure schedules, and transaction closing checklists.
  • Review contracts for legal, commercial, and business risks and summarize key issues for attorney review.
  • Coordinate contract execution, signature collection, and final document management.
  • Maintain organized electronic legal files and document management systems.
  • Track transaction timelines, deadlines, and attorney action items across multiple client matters.
  • Assist with client correspondence and preparation of legal deliverables.
  • Support process improvements and standardization of legal templates and document workflows.


Requirements

  • Education & Licensure: Law Degree (LL.B., J.D., or regional equivalent) from an accredited law school. Active bar admission/license to practice law from Brazil, or a relevant international jurisdiction is strictly required.
  • Experience: 5–10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) practicing corporate law, either within a reputable law firm or as in-house counsel.
  • M&A Expertise: Proven track record of actively working on M&A transactions and drafting/negotiating complex purchase agreements.
  • Language: Native or bilingual fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory, with the ability to draft complex legal documents in English.
  • U.S. Context: Deep experience supporting U.S.-based companies, cross-border transactions, or working under common law principles.
  • Negotiation Skills: Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.


Technical Requirements

  • Document Management: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word (specifically tracking changes and document comparison), Excel, and Google Workspace.
  • Legal Tech: Experience utilizing Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign, ContractWorks) and digital signature workflows.
  • Collaboration: Comfortable operating in agile, remote environments using tools like Teams, Slack, and Zoom.
  • Innovation: Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, specialized legal AI) to drive legal operations efficiency and streamline workflows.

• A collaborative, diverse, and global work environment.

• Involvement in complex international ERP and IFS finance-focused projects.

• Opportunities to act as a finance subject matter expert and contribute to business transformation initiatives.

• Health and wellness benefits to support work-life balance.

If you are looking for an opportunity to make an impact and grow your career in a dynamic, global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, flexibility, expertise, and professional growth.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual Customer Service Representative em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT MASTERPRO

MasterPro Installs is a U.S. appliance delivery and installation company operating in the U.S. We are an authorized installer for some of the largest retailers in the United States. Our trucks deliver and install refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, and cooktops in customers' homes every day, and our remote team in Brazil is the voice our customers hear before and after every visit.

THE ROLE

You will be the direct line between MasterPro and our U.S. customers. You will confirm appointments, solve scheduling problems, follow up after installations, and make sure every customer interaction ends better than it started. You will work inside our CRM and operations systems all day; everything you do gets documented, tracked, and measured. Our field teams are scored on customer surveys, and your work directly moves those scores.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Handle inbound and outbound customer contact by phone, SMS, and email: appointment confirmations, rescheduling, arrival windows, and post-installation follow-up.

• Work daily inside our CRM and operations platforms, keeping every customer record complete, accurate, and up to date — no exceptions.

• Coordinate in real time with U.S.-based dispatch and field teams to solve same-day problems: delays, access issues, product problems, and customer questions.

• Drive customer survey participation and satisfaction after every completed job — our teams are measured on surveys, and you own the follow-up that makes them happen.

• De-escalate frustrated customers with patience and professionalism, and turn complaints into resolved cases with documented outcomes.

• Flag recurring issues and process gaps to management — we promote problem-solvers, not ticket-closers.

REQUIRED

• Fluent, professional English — spoken and written. You will talk with American customers by phone all day. Interviews are conducted 100% in English.

• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Monday.com, or similar). You know how to live inside a CRM: logging, updating, searching, and following workflows.

• 100% remote readiness: reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a computer in good condition, and a quality headset.

• Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours (afternoon/evening in Brazil).

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience serving U.S. or other international customers.

• Experience with Monday.com, scheduling systems, or logistics/home-services operations.

• Spanish, in addition to English — many of our customers are bilingual.

WHAT WE OFFER

• 100% remote work from anywhere in Brazil, on a long-term engagement with a growing U.S. company.

• Compensation in line with experience, paid reliably every month.

• Real growth: our Brazil team members grow into finance, operations, and coordination roles as the company expands into new U.S. markets.

• Direct exposure to U.S. operations, tools, and standards — you will work with modern systems and real automation, not spreadsheets and improvisation.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn AND send your resume in English to with the subject line \"Customer Service — Brazil\". Include one short paragraph, in English, telling us about a difficult customer you turned around. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed — that paragraph is the first test.

• 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada).

• Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional.

• Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente.

• Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Coordenador(a) de Operações
description:

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media 🚀


We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!


Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Note: If you have any more questions or need further assistance for specific arrangements linked to your recruitment process, feel free to contact

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

MasterPro Installs Corp is a fast-growing appliance delivery and installation company serving major retail partners across the U.S., with new markets launching regularly.

Prior remote experience with a U.S.-based company

Remote (International) | Hours aligned with U.S. business hours

title: Analista de Negócios Utilities Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Negócios Utilities Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Inetum , acreditamos que a diversidade é a chave para construir soluções mais criativas e impactantes. Valorizamos cada pessoa pelo que ela é e pelo que pode contribuir, independentemente de raça, etnia, religião, gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é manter um ambiente acolhedor, inclusivo e colaborativo, onde diferentes perspectivas se transformam em inovação e fortalecem nossa cultura.

Estamos presentes em 19 países, com mais de 26.000 colaboradores ao redor do mundo. Se você busca uma empresa que une tecnologia, inovação e respeito às pessoas, a Inetum é o lugar certo para você.


Estamos buscando Analistas de Negócios Utilities Sênior para atuar em projeto de implementação SAP S/4HANA Utilities, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas, levantamento e redesenho de processos no setor de energia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Co-liderar frentes de negócio em projetos de transformação no setor de utilities.
  • Levantar, analisar e redesenhar processos de negócio.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização, automação e simplificação de processos.
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas junto às áreas de negócio e liderança do cliente.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre áreas de negócio, consultoria e equipes técnicas SAP.
  • Realizar benchmarks, análises de mercado e identificação de tendências do setor energético.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de gestão da mudança, adoção tecnológica e comunicação.
  • Contribuir na elaboração de propostas de valor e identificação de novas oportunidades.
  • Orientar consultores e analistas mais juniores.
  • Apoiar workshops, documentação funcional e alinhamentos executivos.


Requisitos

  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de negócios ou projetos no setor de energia/utilities.
  • Conhecimento em processos comerciais e operacionais do setor energético, como:
  • Comercialização;
  • Desenho de produtos;
  • Pricing;
  • Vendas;
  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Faturamento;
  • Cobrança;
  • Gestão de dívida.
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital, otimização de processos ou estratégia comercial.
  • Vivência com clientes, lideranças e ambientes complexos.
  • Capacidade de análise, estruturação de problemas e proposição de soluções.
  • Boa comunicação, perfil consultivo e orientação a resultados.
  • Português e inglês obrigatórios.
  • Espanhol será considerado diferencial.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em projetos SAP S/4HANA Utilities ou SAP IS-U.
  • Vivência no setor elétrico brasileiro.
  • Conhecimento de processos regulatórios do setor de energia.
  • Experiência com gestão da mudança, workshops, design thinking ou adoção tecnológica.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is a boutique creative agency that builds campaigns, brand systems, and content for technology and AI-driven companies. We work with brands you've heard of and some you're about to.


We're looking for a Video Editor + Motion Designer based in Brazil to join our team full-time. This is a remote position reporting directly to our Creative Director.


What you'll do:

  • Edit video content for campaigns, social, product launches, and brand storytelling
  • Create motion graphics, from logo animations to full explainer sequences
  • Experiment with AI video tools (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) to push creative boundaries
  • Deliver across formats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — for web, social, ads, and beyond
  • Work fast, think creatively, and bring your own ideas to the project. We value your perspective!


What we're looking for:

  • Strong portfolio showing both video editing and motion graphics work
  • Proficiency in After Effects, Premiere (or similar NLE)
  • Experience with (or genuine curiosity about) AI-generated video tools
  • Ability to work independently, manage your time, and meet deadlines
  • Great taste in design, knowledge of the latest video editing trends and styles.


Bonus points:

  • Experience creating content for tech, SaaS, or consumer brands,
  • Basis English. But don't worry, your teammates are also based in Brazil.


We use the latest AI tools to move fast and deliver high-quality work for ambitious companies. If you want creative freedom, variety, and the chance to grow with us, please don't hesitate to apply.

A Ten16 Creative é uma agência criativa boutique que desenvolve campanhas, sistemas de marca e conteúdo para empresas de tecnologia e inteligência artificial. Trabalhamos com marcas que você já conhece — e algumas que está prestes a conhecer.

Estamos procurando um Editor de Vídeo + Motion Designer baseado no Brasil para integrar nosso time em tempo integral. A posição é 100% remota, com reporte direto ao nosso Diretor Criativo.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Editar conteúdo em vídeo para campanhas, redes sociais, lançamentos de produto e storytelling de marca
  • Criar motion graphics — de animações de logo a sequências completas de explainer
  • Experimentar com ferramentas de vídeo com IA (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) para expandir os limites criativos
  • Entregar em múltiplos formatos: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — para web, social, ads e mais
  • Trabalhar rápido, pensar criativamente e trazer ideias — não apenas executar briefings

O que estamos buscando:

  • Portfólio sólido mostrando trabalhos de edição de vídeo e motion graphics
  • Domínio de After Effects, Premiere (ou similar)
  • Experiência com (ou curiosidade genuína sobre) ferramentas de vídeo gerado por IA
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, gerenciar seu tempo e cumprir prazos
  • Bom gosto. Sério — a gente se importa com craft.

Pontos extras:

  • Experiência criando conteúdo para marcas de tech, SaaS ou consumer
  • Conforto para trabalhar em inglês (nossos clientes são dos EUA)

Aqui não é fábrica. Somos um time pequeno fazendo trabalho de alta qualidade para empresas ambiciosas. Se você quer liberdade criativa, variedade e a chance de crescer com a gente — manda seu portfólio aqui embaixo ou me chama no DM.

title: PMO (Escritório de projetos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO (Escritório de projetos) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o netLex


O netLex surgiu para revolucionar o mercado de Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), fazendo fluir o trabalho de todos que lidam com documentos. Acreditamos que a experiência deve ser a mais agradável possível e, por que não, divertida?!


Para alcançarmos nosso objetivo, usamos tecnologia para otimizar os processos de formalização e gestão de documentos e, ao fazermos isso, conseguimos extrair mais dados e gerar inteligência. Assim, nossos clientes ( os maiores da América Latina) podem alcançar um novo patamar de excelência e ter acesso a uma série de informações estratégicas para os ajudar a tomar decisões melhores.


Estamos crescendo os nossos times buscando novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo da gestão do ciclo de vida de documentos com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na netLex temos uma cultura bem forte, que se baseia em um ambiente colaborativo e descontraído para nossos netLecos e netLecas!


Valorizamos a diversidade e são muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas pretas, mulheres, PCD, indígenas, LGBTQIA+ ou outros grupos minorizados 🧡


Sobre a oportunidade:


Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da netLex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades comoPMO por aqui?


Governança e Padronização

  • Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização.
  • Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto.
  • Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos.
  • Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento).
  • Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.

Gestão de Recursos e Riscos

  • Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos.
  • Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.

Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura

  • Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura.
  • Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.


Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:


  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner).
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais).
  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level.
  • Experiência em sistemas no modelo SaaS.
  • Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project).
  • Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto.
  • Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação.
  • Ensino superior completo.


Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares).
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.


O que oferecemos:


Modelo Remote First : trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte;

Equipamentos de trabalho : disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade;

Jornada de trabalho flexível : aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido;

Cartão de benefício flexível Caju : valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura);

Plano de saúde e odontológico;

Day off de aniversário : tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento : compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre;

Educalex : benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais!

Stock Options : possibilidade de adquirir ações da netLex de acordo com seu desenvolvimento em nosso plano de carreiras.

description:

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken

Nice-to-have

You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems.

  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention

Azure Cloud & DevOps

  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
