  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations

  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Loyalty

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Quality Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Finding those who are sharp and can navigate ambiguous technical jargon would be a great fit for the role. Day to Day Responsibilities Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality. Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Must Haves: Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities). C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency. 3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred) Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts. Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources. Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team. Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.


NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Plusses: Experience w RLHF (Reinforcement Learning Human Feedback) Multiple Language proficiency Experience with multi modal data annotation (Text, Image, Video) QA or QC experience

title: Coordinador de Planeamiento Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordinador de Planeamiento Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:


Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda


¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?


  • Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.
  • Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.
  • Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en post de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.
  • Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.
  • Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.
  • Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.
  • Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.
  • Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos.
  • Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa.
  • Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.


¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?


  • Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.
  • Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable)
  • Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable).
  • Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable).
  • Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.

What will you do as a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air?


As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air, you will collaborate closely with HR Partners and Business Leaders to identify critical hiring needs and build a strong pipeline of passive candidates. You will manage and coordinate all candidate communications, including screening, feedback, and onboarding, ensuring a seamless and positive experience. Additionally, you will take full ownership of the recruiting process, from requisition approval to onboarding, optimizing efficiency and alignment with business goals. This role will also focus on enhancing the candidate experience while supporting hiring managers in making informed talent decisions. Ultimately, you will contribute to Sealed Air’s success by attracting and securing top talent that is aligned with our strategic objectives.


Why do we need you?


· Develop a strong understanding of Sealed Air’s business, competitive landscape, and overall strategy to enhance business partnerships and recruiting effectiveness.

· Attend trade shows and networking events to build and maintain a robust external network, fostering partnerships that generate a pipeline of key talent for current and future hiring needs.

· Support and collaboratively drive the development and implementation of innovative strategies to attract and assess top talent.

· Leverage all direct recruitment channels, including internal and external job resources, social media, employee referral programs, lead generation sources, alumni networks, professional associations, conferences, and industry events.

· Take ownership of the recruiting process, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for candidates and hiring managers from requisition approval to onboarding.

· Provide ongoing support to hiring managers and HR as needed.

· Conduct intake sessions with hiring managers to identify ideal candidate requirements, establish sourcing strategies, align on recruiting processes, and determine communication methods and frequency.

· Conduct phone screenings with candidates and provide structured feedback to hiring managers based on the agreed-upon communication plan.

· Present an overview of Sealed Air’s business, employee benefits, and professional development opportunities, creating a compelling vision for potential candidates.

· Arrange and facilitate interviews, collect feedback, and coordinate post-interview debriefs with hiring managers for all active positions.

· Partner with HR, Compensation, and Hiring Managers to develop and communicate competitive job offers to candidates.

· Work closely with HR and Hiring Managers to gather and provide timely post-screen and post-interview feedback to candidates.

· Continuously improve all stages of the candidate and hiring manager experience by identifying opportunities, recommending solutions, and contributing to implementation efforts.

Advanced level of Portuguese, Spanish and English required

· Experience with the full recruitment lifecycle.

· Supply Chain

· Experience in Success Factors

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Criador de Conteúdo Sem Experiência :: Apostas Esportivas & iGaming em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A VAGA


A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.


Estamos buscando pessoas sem experiência prévia em criação de conteúdo que queiram aprender, na prática, a produzir vídeos curtos para redes sociais e ser remuneradas por isso desde o primeiro vídeo.


Não exigimos portfólio, equipamento profissional ou seguidores. Exigimos disposição para aprender e consistência.


Você vai entrar por um processo seletivo estruturado e, se aprovado, seguir uma trilha de formação com remuneração crescente conforme desenvolve sua habilidade.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?


Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.


Produzir conteúdo para marcas parceiras devidamente licenciadas pela SPA/MF (Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas).


Evoluir dentro da trilha de progressão da Doppa conforme volume e qualidade dos vídeos.


PONTOS DE ATENÇÃO


É imprescindível ter mais do que 18 anos para se candidatar.


Trabalhamos exclusivamente com operadores licenciados pela SPA/MF e seguimos rigorosamente a Portaria SPA/MF nº 1.231/2024, que regula a publicidade do setor de apostas no Brasil.


Toda comunicação produzida na Doppa segue diretrizes claras de transparência: identificação de parceria, exibição de licença e proibição de qualquer promessa de retorno garantido.


Não trabalhamos com discurso de \"ganhar dinheiro fácil\". Trabalhamos com formação real de criadores dentro de um setor regulamentado, sério e em expansão.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.

We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.

  • Collaborating with international product teams to navigate cross-border compliance requirements
  • Supporting the Head of Compliance in rolling out a robust compliance programme

  • 4+ years of experience advising on compliance-related matters
  • The ability to analyse and interpret data to guide regulatory strategy
  • A solid understanding of the interplay between compliance risk and business risk
  • The ability to communicate positively with regulators and members of various internal teams
  • Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of learning complex, new regulations quickly

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Member of the Board of Advisors em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Nice to Have

Tech Requirements

Schedule

Ready to Apply?

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants.   • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies

  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager


Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.


Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.


2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.


3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.


5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.


Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).


🛠️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.


Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.


🚀 High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.


Application Process:


Step 1: Submit Application

  • Current CV/resume
  • Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted)
  • Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked


Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.


Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.


Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.


Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.


Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

description:

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.

Apply Today

title: Presales Solution Architect, OSS
description:

  • Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection.
  • Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers.

  • Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny.

  • Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.
  • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.


Requirements:

Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).
  • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).
  • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
  • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

title: Field-Programmable Gate Arrays Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Field-Programmable Gate Arrays Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior FPGA Engineer – Quantum Products & Solutions

Role is based in Abu Dhabi - WILL REQUIRE RELOCATION


This Senior FPGA Engineer role is building next-generation quantum sensing hardware


  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE - Full Relocation supported.
  • Salary: Competitive, DOE – 110-130K+ Euro equivalent + amazing benefits & relocation + Private Education allowance for families + x2 First month salary + free flights out and home + private healthcare & Dental for you and family etc etc.
  • Job Type: Permanent - (Visa for you / Spouse)


About the Business

A well-funded and R&D group (Been around for 10yrs+ & 1000+ team)... developing next-generation quantum technology for real-world applications.


About the Role

The role spans applications including magnetic sensing and inertial navigation, working closely with physicists, embedded systems engineers, and software engineers to turn scientific requirements into robust hardware.


You'll take a lead role on timing closure, verification, and technical direction, + oversight of outsourced FPGA development.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Architect, design, and implement FPGA-based digital hardware for quantum sensing platforms & systems.
  • Develop and maintain RTL designs in VHDL/Verilog for real-time signal acquisition, processing, and control
  • Lead hardware/software co-design, interfacing FPGAs with ADCs/DACs, high-speed serial links, and embedded processors
  • Implement and optimise high-speed data pipelines (filtering, triggering, DSP chains) within FPGA fabric
  • Lead timing closure, resource optimisation, and verification of FPGA designs, including simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test
  • Develop and maintain testbenches and verification worlds.
  • Supervise outsourced FPGA development and contribute to technical reviews
  • Prepare technical documentation including design specs, test reports, and user manuals
  • Debug, validate, and optimise performance using lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyser, spectrum analyser)
  • Participate in laboratory and field testing of integrated systems


What We're Looking For

Essential:

  • Strong proficiency in VHDL and/or Verilog for FPGA design
  • Experience with major FPGA toolchains (Xilinx Vivado, Intel/Altera Quartus)
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces (JESD204B/C, SerDes, DDR memory controllers)
  • Strong understanding of timing closure, clock domain crossing, and resource optimisation
  • Experience interfacing FPGAs with ADCs/DACs and analogue frontends
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, PCIe)
  • Experience with hardware bring-up, debugging, and validation
  • Proficiency with version control (Git, SVN)
  • Experience with simulation/verification tools (ModelSim, QuestaSim) and testbench development
  • Experience with scripting (Python, Tcl) for design automation and test
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work across physics, electronics, and software disciplines
  • Degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years' relevant experience in FPGA or digital hardware design, ideally within R&D or sensing


Desirable:

  • Experience with soft-core processors (MicroBlaze, NIOS II) and FPGA/SoC platforms (Xilinx Zynq)
  • Experience with High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
  • Experience with schematics, PCB-level considerations, and signal integrity
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for hardware/firmware validation


What's On Offer

  • Fully supported relocation to Abu Dhabi, including one month's hotel accommodation and food on arrival
  • First month's salary doubled to help with relocation costs
  • Education allowance of AED 30,000 per child, per year (ages 2-18)
  • Annual flights home for you and your family
  • 25 days annual leave plus 12 public holidays
  • Private healthcare and dental cover for you and your family
  • Free lunch provided onsite daily


If this sounds like the right move for you, to do something really interesting with a really nice and diverse team of engineers that love to collabrate and drive new technology....


We have helped over 300+ engineers relocate and have made this career move smooth and easy and support any questions and information required to ensure you feel comfortable with this exciting move.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail

title: Professor de francês
description:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);

Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) Consultant to join our team. As a senior consultant, you will be responsible for designing and implementing integrated S&OP solutions in SAP S/4HANA, leading demand and supply planning workshops , and providing business consulting and analysis expertise to drive business transformation .

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design: Design SAP S/4HANA S&OP solutions and define demand planning, supply planning, and inventory optimization processes. Business Analysis: Lead S&OP business workshops, elicit planning requirements, and document As-Is/To-Be processes across demand and supply functions. System Integration: Align planning processes with production, procurement, and sales; ensure integration across supply chain and finance. Implementation & Configuration: Configure SAP IBP/APO/S&OP solutions, set up forecasting models, and enable scenario planning and simulations. Project Leadership: Define scope and timelines for S&OP workstreams and coordinate data integration. Performance Optimization: Improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory and service levels, and leverage analytics for decision support.

✅ Job Requirements

8+ years of SAP ECC and S/4HANA planning solution experience. Expertise in SAP IBP, APO, and S&OP configuration. Deep knowledge of demand/supply planning, forecasting models, and inventory optimization. Proven manufacturing experience (Required). Automotive industry experience is a strong plus. 1–2 full lifecycle implementations. Advanced/Fluent English language skills are mandatory. Business consulting experience, with a demonstrated track record of acting as a Business Consultant or Business Analyst in SAP transformation programs.
