title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $20–30/hour

Type: Freelance contractor

Hours: Expecting 40–80 hours/month to start

Path: Potential to move into full-time within a few months


About trends.ceo


trends.ceo works with CEOs, executives, and senior leaders at high-trust firms.

Our work is not generic corporate video or random social clips. We help serious leaders turn their best ideas, experience, and perspective into sharp editorial video that feels credible, modern, and worth watching.

The work sits between documentary, executive communications, and premium social video. It requires strong storytelling, clean taste, and the ability to make complex business ideas feel clear and compelling.

We’re looking for a senior editor who can help us raise the creative standard.


The role


You’ll edit executive interviews and leadership content into polished short-form and mid-form videos for a business audience.

This role is for someone with strong creative direction and editorial sense. We need an editor who understands what footage to include, when to use it, how to shape pacing, where sound design matters, and how to make senior leaders look credible, natural, and engaging.


Responsibilities


Edit executive interviews into high-quality short-form and mid-form videos.

Find strong hooks, story arcs, insights, and human moments in raw footage.

Shape complex business topics into clear, compelling edits.

Make smart choices on b-roll, cutaways, pacing, music, sound design, captions, graphics, and text treatment.

Use AI tools where helpful to storyboard ideas, create simple animations, generate visual references, or support lightweight visual concepts.

Maintain a premium, modern, editorial visual style.

Work with our creative team to apply feedback quickly.

Stay organized, meet deadlines, and manage project files properly.


What we’re looking for


5+ years of professional video editing experience.

A strong portfolio with relevant interview, documentary, corporate, editorial, or premium social samples.

Excellent storytelling instincts.

Strong taste in pacing, structure, music, sound design, and visual polish.

Experience editing business, executive, documentary, or high-end interview content.

Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

After Effects and AI tools are a strong plus.

Comfort using AI tools as part of the creative process.

Strong English comprehension.

Reliable, organized, and comfortable working remotely.

What matters most


You can find the story inside the footage.

You know the difference between a generic clip and a strong idea.

You understand when to use b-roll, when to stay on the speaker, and when the edit needs breathing room.

You can make senior people look sharp without making the work feel overproduced.

You bring creative opinions, not just technical execution.

Application process


Please send:

Your portfolio or 3–5 relevant video samples.

A short note on your experience editing interviews or executive/business content.

Your hourly rate.

Your monthly availability.

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test .

title: Head of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Finance- Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.


The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.
  • Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.
  • Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.
  • Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

Treasury & Banking

  • Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.
  • Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.
  • Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.
  • Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.
  • Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.
  • Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Why Join VelaFi?

Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.


This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.


The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.
  • Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.
  • Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.
  • Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

Treasury & Banking

  • Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.
  • Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.
  • Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.
  • Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.
  • Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.
  • Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Why Join VelaFi?

Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.


This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual Customer Service Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT MASTERPRO

MasterPro Installs is a U.S. appliance delivery and installation company operating in the U.S. We are an authorized installer for some of the largest retailers in the United States. Our trucks deliver and install refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, and cooktops in customers' homes every day, and our remote team in Brazil is the voice our customers hear before and after every visit.

THE ROLE

You will be the direct line between MasterPro and our U.S. customers. You will confirm appointments, solve scheduling problems, follow up after installations, and make sure every customer interaction ends better than it started. You will work inside our CRM and operations systems all day; everything you do gets documented, tracked, and measured. Our field teams are scored on customer surveys, and your work directly moves those scores.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Handle inbound and outbound customer contact by phone, SMS, and email: appointment confirmations, rescheduling, arrival windows, and post-installation follow-up.

• Work daily inside our CRM and operations platforms, keeping every customer record complete, accurate, and up to date — no exceptions.

• Coordinate in real time with U.S.-based dispatch and field teams to solve same-day problems: delays, access issues, product problems, and customer questions.

• Drive customer survey participation and satisfaction after every completed job — our teams are measured on surveys, and you own the follow-up that makes them happen.

• De-escalate frustrated customers with patience and professionalism, and turn complaints into resolved cases with documented outcomes.

• Flag recurring issues and process gaps to management — we promote problem-solvers, not ticket-closers.

REQUIRED

• Fluent, professional English — spoken and written. You will talk with American customers by phone all day. Interviews are conducted 100% in English.

• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Monday.com, or similar). You know how to live inside a CRM: logging, updating, searching, and following workflows.

• 100% remote readiness: reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a computer in good condition, and a quality headset.

• Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours (afternoon/evening in Brazil).

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience serving U.S. or other international customers.

• Experience with Monday.com, scheduling systems, or logistics/home-services operations.

• Spanish, in addition to English — many of our customers are bilingual.

WHAT WE OFFER

• 100% remote work from anywhere in Brazil, on a long-term engagement with a growing U.S. company.

• Compensation in line with experience, paid reliably every month.

• Real growth: our Brazil team members grow into finance, operations, and coordination roles as the company expands into new U.S. markets.

• Direct exposure to U.S. operations, tools, and standards — you will work with modern systems and real automation, not spreadsheets and improvisation.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn AND send your resume in English to with the subject line \"Customer Service — Brazil\". Include one short paragraph, in English, telling us about a difficult customer you turned around. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed — that paragraph is the first test.

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Quality Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Finding those who are sharp and can navigate ambiguous technical jargon would be a great fit for the role. Day to Day Responsibilities Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality. Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Must Haves: Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities). C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency. 3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred) Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts. Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources. Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team. Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.

description:

What will you do as a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air?


As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air, you will collaborate closely with HR Partners and Business Leaders to identify critical hiring needs and build a strong pipeline of passive candidates. You will manage and coordinate all candidate communications, including screening, feedback, and onboarding, ensuring a seamless and positive experience. Additionally, you will take full ownership of the recruiting process, from requisition approval to onboarding, optimizing efficiency and alignment with business goals. This role will also focus on enhancing the candidate experience while supporting hiring managers in making informed talent decisions. Ultimately, you will contribute to Sealed Air’s success by attracting and securing top talent that is aligned with our strategic objectives.

· Develop a strong understanding of Sealed Air’s business, competitive landscape, and overall strategy to enhance business partnerships and recruiting effectiveness.

· Attend trade shows and networking events to build and maintain a robust external network, fostering partnerships that generate a pipeline of key talent for current and future hiring needs.

· Continuously improve all stages of the candidate and hiring manager experience by identifying opportunities, recommending solutions, and contributing to implementation efforts.

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA

que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.


Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.


O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA

Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:


• Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara

agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta

comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.

• Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.

• Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.

• Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.

• Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.

• Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq,

integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy.


O que você vai fazer


Manutenção do core (40%)

• Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade

ciclomática.

• Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem

determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.

• Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.

• Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).

• Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.


Evolução de agents e rules (35%)

• Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).

• Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.

• Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev

ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).

• Criar/refatorar skills.

• Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).


Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)

• Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).

• Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex:

DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).

• Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.

• Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;

expandir cobertura).

• Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection —

entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.


O que esperamos de você


Stack técnica — obrigatório

• Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de

bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs,

parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((

e porque importa.

• Node.js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node

(ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).

• Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr

create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução

de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.

• Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o

efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.


Experiência

• 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.

• Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente

real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\".

• Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\".

• Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).


Mentalidade

• Determinismo > magia. Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.

• Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.

• Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta.

• Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.


Diferenciais

• Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.

• Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.

• Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende

os trade-offs.

• Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent

frameworks).

• Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.

• Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico

(feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).

• Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.


Benefícios

• Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde

• Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco

• Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life

• Day Off de Aniversário

• TotalPass

• Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.


Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST


Benefits

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

Loyalty

Integrity

Strong Work Ethic

Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset

Team Player / Caring / Selfless

Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

Freedom & Accountability

About the role

The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale.

We're looking for a motivated Finance Services Manager to manage treasury account onboarding processes and financial portal accesses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of SQL, Excel, and/or Python with impressive data analysis skills
  • Solid relationship management, project management, and leadership skills



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

title: Immigration Post‑Filing Assistant / Legal Assistant (Portuguese/English Speaker)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Immigration Post‑Filing Assistant / Legal Assistant (Portuguese/English Speaker) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Bueno Law Corp


Bueno Law Corp is a mission‑driven immigration law firm dedicated to helping survivors of domestic violence, LGBTQ+ immigrants, and other vulnerable individuals build safe, stable lives in the United States. We provide compassionate, trauma‑informed representation while maintaining the highest standards of legal excellence, and ethicality.


About the Role


We’re hiring a highly organized Immigration Post‑Filing Assistant / Legal Assistant to support post‑filing workflows across humanitarian and family‑based immigration matters. This role manages government follow‑ups, SIJS case coordination, EAD processing, and client preparation throughout USCIS, consular, and court processes.


What You’ll Do


  • File and track FOIA requests, congressional inquiries, USCIS service requests, lockbox emails, and government notices.
  • Monitor case updates (receipts, biometrics, interviews, RFEs) and maintain accurate records in Clio and G‑Drive.
  • Schedule medical exams and biometrics abroad; re‑schedule domestic biometrics; prepare interview packets.
  • File AR‑11/E‑33 address changes and update all administrative changes in Clio.
  • Prepare and file initial and renewal EAD applications; track 150‑day asylum EAD timelines and annual fee payments.
  • Re‑submit rejected filings; revise case materials based on FOIA results.
  • SIJS Support: serve respondents/agencies, check probate notes, prepare hearing packets, coordinate hearings, monitor Greenfiling, obtain court orders, and track judgment deadlines.
  • Draft case‑closure letters for attorney review.


What You Bring


  • 1–3 years of fast paced detail oriented administrative work experience (immigration legal support or case management experience preferred).
  • Ability to multi-task, and prioritize.
  • Proactivity.
  • Excellent organization, accuracy, and communication skills.
  • Experience with Clio preferred.
  • Bilingual Portuguese / English.
  • Ability to work 9:00AM-6:00PM (US Pacific Time Zone)


What We Offer


  • Competitive pay
  • Training designed to help you succeed
  • Paid vacation, sick leave, and birthdays off
  • U.S. paid holidays
  • Clear, structured growth opportunities within the firm
  • Fully remote, full‑time position

  • Automotive industry experience.

  • Experience with global templates, multi-country rollouts, or large enterprise environments.
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with North American business culture and delivery expectations.


Why Join Us?

  • Work with a global technology organization on enterprise SAP transformation initiatives.
  • Support a strategic planning project in a complex manufacturing environment.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders.
  • Contribute to high-impact SAP S/4HANA, IBP, APO, and S&OP work.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.

  • Audit

This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:

Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.

  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference
